title: News & Events
description: Stay connected to the sport horse world with trusted news sources and direct links to major event calendars.
liveFeedDescription: The first release uses curated, official and established sources. A live feed, filters, favourites and personalised event alerts can be added next.
liveFeedIntro: Fresh headlines from established equestrian media. Open the original article for the full story.
liveFeedUnavailable: Live news is temporarily unavailable. The trusted source links below are still available.
newsDescription: Quick access to trusted equestrian news and show-jumping coverage.
eventsDescription: Jump straight to competition calendars and official event information.
verifiedLinksDescription: Links are curated toward official federations, organisers and established equestrian media.
personalizationDescription: Future versions can filter events by country, discipline, distance and your favourite horses.
alertsDescription: Future alerts can notify you when selected competitions or important equestrian stories are published.
eventsFinderDescription: Browse live FEI events, open the official event page, or save competitions for later.
eventDetailsDescription: This information comes from the live FEI event feed. Use the official event page for the complete schedule, venue information, entries, results, and organiser updates.
remindersDescription: Choose a reminder for saved events. Preferences are stored on this device.
calendarDescription: Saved from the Shabdiz News & Events calendar.
timedCalendarHint: A timed calendar entry will be exported.
allDayCalendarHint: No reliable start time is available, so this exports as an all-day event.
timeReminderUnavailable: Time-specific reminders need a reliable event start time.
calendarUnavailable: A calendar file cannot be created until a reliable event date is available.
